# Accessibility Audit: Keyboard And Contrast

BEGIN_CORPUS_15-accessibility-audit

This **DECISION_SENTINEL_15-accessibility-audit** records representative accessibility audit prose with enough context to evaluate sustained reading.

See [LINK_SENTINEL_15-accessibility-audit](https://example.invalid/15-accessibility-audit) for the referenced evidence.

## HEADING_SENTINEL_15-accessibility-audit

- LIST_SENTINEL_15-accessibility-audit
- Supporting context stays close to the decision it explains.
- The final claim names the observation that would falsify it.

## Keyboard observations
- Focus order follows the visible reading order: Tab → link → heading.
- Link roles and names survive semantic rendering.
- Reduced-motion policy removes unrequested animation.
